s: ekAraH । sa tu ekAdaSasvaravarRaH । asyoccAraRasTAnaMtAlukaRWaSca । (yaduktaM sidDAntakOmudyAm । “edEtoH kaRWatAlu” । taTAca SikzAyAm । “eE tukaRWatAlavyAvo O kaRWozWajO smftO” ॥) sa dIrGaH plutaSca Bavati । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ (udAttAnudAttasvaritaBedAt triviDo'pi pratyekaM punaranunAsikAnanunAsikaBedAt zaqviDaeva ॥) “ekAraM paramaM divyaM brahmavizRuSivAtmakam । raYjinIkusumapraKyaM paYcadevamayaM sadA ॥ paYcaprARAtmakaM varRaM taTA vindutrayAtmakam । caturvvargapradaM deci svayaM paramakuRqalI” ॥ iti kAmaDenutantraM ॥ (vaNgIyaBAzAyAM) asya leKanaprakAro yaTA । “kuYcitA vAmato reKA dakzakoRAyatA tvaDaH । punarvvAmagatA sEva tAsu vahnISavAyavaH” ॥ iti varRodDAratantram ॥ * ॥ asya nAmAni yaTA । “ekAro vAstavaH SaktirJiRwI sozWo BagaM marut । sUkzmA BUto'rdDakeSI ca jyotsnA SradDA pramarddanaH । BayaM jYAnaM kfzA DIrA jaNGA sarvvasamudBavaH । vahvirvizRurBagavatI kuRqalI mohinI vasaH ॥ yozidADAraSaktiSca trikoRA ISasaMjYakaH । sanDirekAdaSI BadrA padmanABaH kulAcalaH” ॥ iti tantraSAstram ॥ * ॥ anyacca । “ekAro vAmagaRqAntaH SaktirJiRwI BagantaTA । mAkzavIjaYca vijayA ozWa ekAdaSasvaraH” ॥ iti vIjavarRABiDAnam ॥ (mAtfkAnyAse'sya ozWasTAne nyasyatayA ozWaSabdenApyaBiDAnam । BAtfkAnyAsamantro yaTA, -- “EM nama ozWe EM namo'Dare” ॥ iti । anubanDaviSezaH । tena luNi sici avfdDiH syAt । yaTAha kavikalpadrume ॥ “xraNvAnirvATa eH sici । avfdDiH EryajAdiH syAt” ॥ etena kawe varzAvarRayorityasya luNi akawIditi syAt ॥)
vya, smftiH । asUyA । anukampA । AmantraRam । AhvAnam । iti medinI ॥
puM, (eti prApnoti sarvvaMviSvamiti । iR + ac । “sarvvaM vizRumayaM jagat” iti vAkyAdasya taTAtvam ॥) vizRuH । ityekAkzarakozaH ॥
v: ekAraH svaravarRaBedaH ezaH “edetO kaRWatAlavyAvityukteH kaRWatAlvoH sTAnayoruccAryyaH । sa ca dIrGaH dvimAtratvAt udAttAnudAttasvaritaBerdaranunAsikAnanunAsikABedaByAYca zaqviDaH । tasya mAtfkAnyAse UrdDvozWasTAne nyasyatayA tacCabdenApyaBiDeyatA । tasya DyeyarUpaM kAmaDenutantre । “ekAraM paramaM divyaM brahmavizRuSivAtmakam । raYjinI kusumapraKyam paYcadevamayaM sadA । paYcaprARAtmakaM varRRaM taTA vindutrayAtmakam । caturvargapradaM devi! DyAyet parama kuRqalIm” । eSabdasya vAcakAH SabdAstantre uktA yaTA “ekAro vAstavaM SaktirJiRWISOzWO BagaM marut । sUkzmo BUto'rdDakeSI ca jyotsnA SradDA pramarddanaH । BayaM jYAnaM kfSA DIrA jaNGA sarvasamudBavaH । vahnirvizRurBagavatI kuRqalI mohinI vasuH । yozidADAraSaktiSca trikoRA ISasaMjYakaH । sanDirekAdaSI BadrA padmanABaH kulAcalaH” । “ekAro vAmagaRqAntaH SaktirJiRwI BagantaTA । mAkzavIjaYca vijayA ozWaH ekAdaSasvaraH” iti vIjavarRABiDAnam

m: 1. ए the eleventh vowel of the alphabet (corresponding to the letter e as pronounced in prey, grey).

4. ए (आ-√ इ) P. -एति, to come near or towards, go near, approach, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. &c.; (with and without पुनर्) to come back, come again to, AitBr.; MBh.; Kathās. &c.; to reach, attain, enter, come into (a state or position), Mn. xii, 125; Megh.; Prab. &c.; to submit, fall to one's share, ChUp. v, 14, 1 (आययन्ति ?), KaṭhUp. : Intens. Ā. (3. du. -इयाते; 1. pl. -ईमहे) to hasten near, RV. vii, 39, 2; to request, VS. iv, 5.
a: ए — {c2c} P. (आ+इ). To come, approach &c.; (see इ).
एः — m. N. of Viṣṇu. --ind. An interjection of (1) remembering; (2) envy; (3) compassion; (4) calling; (5) contempt or censure.
